per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should provide clear and reliable feedback to users during and after booking a room, including email confirmations.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall give users feedback when necessary. 80% of the users surveyed report that the product accurately confirms their actions.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should respond to user actions within 5 seconds for basic tasks and within 10 seconds for most tasks.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: The response shall be fast enough to avoid interrupting the user's flow of thought. 90% of tasks shall complete within 5 seconds. 98% of tasks shall complete within 8 seconds.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should be accessible to users with disabilities, including support for screen readers, keyboard navigation, and high-contrast themes, and should comply with ADA standards.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall conform to the Americans with Disabilities Act.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should be available with very high uptime, targeting 99.99% availability to minimize downtime.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'Aside from server failure the software product shall achieve 99.99% up time.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should provide clear and actionable error messages that explain what went wrong and suggest next steps.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall give users feedback when necessary. 80% of the users surveyed report that the product accurately confirms their actions.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should support at least eight different browsers and ensure that it renders correctly on at least 80% of them.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product must be able to interface with any HTML browser. The product shall transmit data between the user and the product without problems. The product shall display HTML properly in 80% of all HTML browsers tested (minimum is to test 8 browsers).'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should support internationalization, including locale-aware dates/times, translations, and time zones.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: The product shall be able to display calendar dates and times according to the user's locale. 90% of survey respondents from each target market country will find that the date and time formatting of the product is correct.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should support mobile access for users.
